R & D process done at Units are for process improvement. There is no R&D investments made in the area to improve the environmental and social impacts of product and processes.

SR - The main product of the Company is an input materials for our customers who in turn finally produce the finished products. Once the products are sold they would not come back to the company. Hence company is not required to reclaim the products. DO - The plastic waste generated is disposed off as per plastic waste management rule 2016. Compliance and returns are submitted regularly as per rules. DSW - EPR applicable for plastic packaging is being fulfilled as per plastic waste management rule-2016.

SR - This is not applicable as Shriram Rayons Unit is not reclaiming any electronic items. All e-waste generated in-house is handed over to certified vendors for safe disposal. DO & DSW - The E-waste generated is disposed off as per E-Waste management rules. Compliance and returns are submitted regularly as per rules

SR - Not applicable as our products is 100% bio-degradable however in house generation of hazardous waste is handeled, stored, disposed by agency authorised by Rajasthan State Pollution Control Board. DO - All the hazardous waste generated is disposed off to authorised vendor as per authorization. DSW - Entire hazardous waste is being burned in captive power plant.
